title: Boss: get me out of here
summary: Simulate a real vim survival session from first key to saved file.

steps.title: A colleague is stuck
steps.body: A colleague's terminal is full of strange text and vim will not quit. You will build a tiny vim that understands enough keys to replay exactly what they typed.

steps.title: Insert-mode typing
prompt: Write `string TypeLine(string line, int col, string keys)` that edits one line. The cursor starts at index `col` (on a character) in normal mode. Keys (one character each):
- normal: `i` insert before the cursor, `a` insert after it, `I` insert at index 0, `A` insert at the end; other keys are ignored.
- insert: Esc (`\u001b`) back to normal (the cursor moves one left, as in vim, but not below 0); any other character is inserted at the insertion point, which then advances.
starter: string TypeLine(string line, int col, string keys)
solution: string TypeLine(string line, int col, string keys)
else if (k == 'a') { insert = true; pos = Math.Min(pos + 1, sb.Length); }
else if (k == 'A') { insert = true; pos = sb.Length; }
else if (k == '\u001b') { insert = false; pos = Math.Max(0, pos - 1); }
hints: Track `insert` (bool) and `pos` (where the next character goes).
On Esc, vim puts the cursor on the last character you typed: `pos - 1`.
template: {{CODE}}
Dojo.Eq("A appends", "port 8080", TypeLine("port 80", 0, "A80\u001b"));
Dojo.Eq("i inserts before", "Xabc", TypeLine("abc", 0, "iX\u001b"));
Dojo.Eq("a inserts after", "aXbc", TypeLine("abc", 0, "aX\u001b"));
Dojo.Eq("I goes to the start", "# listen 80;", TypeLine("listen 80;", 7, "I# \u001b"));
Dojo.Eq("after Esc the cursor moved left, so a lands back where you were", "abXYc", TypeLine("abc", 1, "aX\u001baY\u001b"));
Dojo.Eq("normal-mode junk is ignored", "abc", TypeLine("abc", 0, "hjkl"));

steps.title: Replay the panic
prompt: Write `List<string> Replay(string keys)` that replays keys typed into vim on an **empty, unmodified** file and returns the log of what vim reports for each Ex command run with Enter. Rules:
- Modes as in lesson 1: normal, insert (entered with `i a o A I O`), command (entered with `:`).
- In insert mode every character except Esc is text; typing text marks the buffer **modified**.
- In command mode, characters build the command until Enter (`\n`); Esc cancels it.

- Running a command logs: `:w` → `"written"` (buffer no longer modified), `:q` → `"E37"` if modified else `"quit"`, `:q!` → `"quit"`, `:wq`/`:x` → `"written, quit"` for `:wq`, and for `:x` the same if modified else `"quit"`. Anything else → `"E492: Not an editor command: <cmd>"`.
- After any result containing `quit`, stop processing keys.
solution: else result = "E492: Not an editor command: " + c;
hints: Three modes, one `StringBuilder` for the command being typed.
`break` out of the loop after a result containing `quit`.
template: {{CODE}}
Dojo.Eq("quit a clean file", new List<string> { "quit" }, Replay(":q\n"));
Dojo.Eq("typing then :q is refused, then :q! works", new List<string> { "E37", "quit" }, Replay("ihello\u001b:q\n:q!\n"));
Dojo.Eq(":wq typed in insert mode is just text", new List<string>(), Replay("i:wq\n"));
Dojo.Eq("save then quit", new List<string> { "written", "quit" }, Replay("ohi\u001b:w\n:q\n"));
Dojo.Eq("Esc cancels a command", new List<string> { "written, quit" }, Replay("ix\u001b:q\u001b:wq\n"));
Dojo.Eq("typo", new List<string> { "E492: Not an editor command: qw", "quit" }, Replay(":qw\n:x\n"));
Dojo.Eq("nothing after quit runs", new List<string> { "quit" }, Replay(":q\n:w\n"));

steps.title: Write the instructions
prompt: Your colleague is in an unknown mode. Write `string Rescue(bool keepChanges, bool insideCmdWindow)` returning the exact key sequence, keys separated by single spaces, that always gets them out:
- If `insideCmdWindow` (they typed `q:`), start with `:q Enter` to close that window.
For example `Rescue(false, false)` returns `Esc Esc :q! Enter`.
hints: Build a list of parts and `string.Join(" ", parts)`.
template: {{CODE}}
Dojo.Eq("discard", "Esc Esc :q! Enter", Rescue(false, false));
Dojo.Eq("keep", "Esc Esc :wq Enter", Rescue(true, false));
Dojo.Eq("from the command-line window", ":q Enter Esc Esc :q! Enter", Rescue(false, true));
Dojo.Eq("keep from the command-line window", ":q Enter Esc Esc :wq Enter", Rescue(true, true));
